replacements.El ciclo de Von Neumann: cómo ejecuta un: The von Neumann cycle: how the processor executes an instruction
replacements.Cuatro fases que se repiten miles de mil: Four phases repeated billions of times per second. The architecture described by this cycle is the basis of almost all current processors.
replacements.La unidad de control lee la dirección de: The control unit reads the address in the PC (Program Counter) register, fetches the instruction stored at that memory address, and loads it into the IR (Instruction Register). The PC is incremented by 1 to point to the next instruction.
replacements.Activo: Memoria + Unidad de control + Re: Active: Memory + Control unit + Registers (PC, IR)
replacements.PC=42 → Memoria[42] → IR = \"ADD R1, R2\: PC=42 → Memory[42] → IR = "ADD R1, R2" · PC = 43
replacements.La unidad de control lee la dirección al: The control unit reads the address stored in the PC (Program Counter), accesses Memory[PC], and loads the instruction into the IR (Instruction Register). The PC is incremented to point to the next instruction.
replacements.PC=42 → leer Memoria[42] → IR = \"ADD R1: PC=42 → read Memory[42] → IR = "ADD R1, R2" · PC = 43
replacements.La unidad de control descompone el conte: The control unit breaks the contents of the IR into its fields: operation code (opcode), source registers, and destination register. It determines which operation the ALU will perform and which registers it needs.
replacements.Ejecutar la operación en la ALU: Execute the operation in the ALU
replacements.La ALU (Arithmetic Logic Unit) recibe lo: The ALU (Arithmetic Logic Unit) receives the operands from the specified registers and performs the operation determined in the decode phase. The result remains in a temporary register. For jump instructions, the PC is also updated.
replacements.ALU: R1 + R2 = 5 + 3 = 8 · resultado → r: ALU: R1 + R2 = 5 + 3 = 8 · result → temporary register T
replacements.El resultado del registro temporal T se: The result from temporary register T is written to the destination register specified in the instruction. If the instruction accesses memory (STORE), the result is also written to the corresponding memory address.
replacements.R1 ← T = 8 · R1 ahora vale 8 · listo par: R1 ← T = 8 · R1 is now 8 · ready for the next instruction
